name: 尼达尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3888
who: Nidar, a dwarf, head craftsman of the Furnace Guild of the Smelting Heart mountain, two hundred and two and looking a little past fifty, older than a dwarf of his standing should look, worn by a hundred and sixty years of watching the master furnace: short, about 132 cm, his head level with a human's chest, broad and solid but a hand narrower in the shoulders than the burliest dwarf smiths. Steel-blue hair combed back and a steel-blue beard parted into two braided strands, each held by a ring of mountain copper. Eyes the bluish white of a magic-crystal flame. Around his brow an old pale burn ring left by the furnace crown. All ten knuckles worn flat and shiny from a century of winding rune cages. Small pointed ears. No goggles and no jewellery. A slow, level, unhurried air; he never raises his voice.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered dwarf face of a little past fifty, bluish-white eyes with a faint cold glow, steel-blue brows, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, a wide nose, a steel-blue beard parted into two braided strands each held by a mountain-copper ring, a pale old burn mark running in a ring around the brow, small pointed ears; skin a warm ruddy tone from the furnace.
build: 132 cm, short, broad and solid, heavy forearms, a little narrower in the shoulders than the burliest dwarf smiths.
palette: steel blue and mountain copper, crystal-flame blue-white, soot-black leather, furnace orange
casual: His guild work dress: a heavy dark leather forge apron pocked with small spark holes over a thick charcoal wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a wide belt with a wrench as long as his forearm hung at the hip, dark trousers and iron-capped boots. He raises one hand with the flattened knuckles as if about to rap a furnace casing, a calm, measuring look.
private: Off the furnace floor: the apron off, a sleeveless leather vest over the charcoal wool shirt, soft boots. He holds a small folded paper of figures and a stub of charcoal, a tired, quiet look.
battle: On the night he gathered in every fire of the mountain: the furnace crown on his brow, a ring of black mountain copper forged from the master furnace's first hoop, with a row of small furnace-door openings across its front through which the furnace fire glows orange and blue-white; a riveted leather forge cuirass with rune-cut plates glowing at the seams over the wool shirt, thick iron bracers and heavy gloves. He grips a long-handled forge hammer in both hands, its head scored with rune lines and glowing like a furnace mouth, a heavy, level, unflinching look.
formal: Before the master furnace at a guild rite: a long charcoal wool guild coat to the shins, closing down the front with a row of copper buttons, the guild's furnace badge in copper on the chest, a wide belt, polished boots, the two beard braids oiled and their copper rings polished. He holds the furnace crown, the ring of black mountain copper with its row of small glowing furnace-door openings, in both hands before his chest, not wearing it, a grave look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the bluish-white eyes looking at the viewer, the furnace crown on his brow with orange and blue-white fire showing through its row of tiny furnace doors, firelight under his chin. Deep night-blue light from one side, the glow of a whole mountain of furnaces from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, a coil of mountain-copper wire, the edge of a hammer head.

name: 安玛拉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3908
who: Anmara, a demon-kin priestess of the vine-tending clan of the Thousand-Trellis Valley, ninety and looking thirty-five or so: about 170 cm, slender and long-limbed. Long hair the green of new vine shoots trailing all the way down to her heels, the ends always curling into fresh tendrils. Pomegranate-red eyes. A pair of horns sweeping back from the temples, wound with thin vines that bear small white flowers. Pale skin with a faint green cast and fine leaf-green veins at the wrists. She goes barefoot, and tiny green grass shoots sprout where her feet have stood. At her waist hangs half of a cracked clay pot, the pot the mother vine grew from. No jewellery. A soft-voiced, earth-minded air; she crouches and puts her hand into the soil before she looks at anyone.
build: 170 cm, slender and long-limbed: strong hands and forearms from cutting vine, a modest bust, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: vine green and leaf green, pomegranate red, undyed hemp, white blossom, earthen clay brown
casual: Her clan dress: a long sleeveless tunic dress of undyed vine-fibre cloth to the ankles, belted with a plaited vine cord, the hem frayed into little tendrils, a short shawl of the same cloth over the shoulders; the half cracked clay pot hangs at her waist on a cord; a short bone knife in a plain sheath at the other hip; bare feet with small grass shoots at the heels. She stands with her hands loosely open, earth on her fingertips, a quiet, gentle look.
private: At her clan's tents at dawn: a loose long-sleeved hemp shift, the long green hair gathered over one shoulder, bare feet. She holds a small wooden cup of water in both hands, saving a mouthful for the vine, a calm, private look.
battle: Leading her clan against the reapers: the vine-fibre dress belted tight under a harness of hardened bark plates laced with living vine that puts out thorns, bark bracers, the half clay pot at her waist, bare feet with green shoots at the heels. She grips the short bone knife in her right hand, her left hand open and low with living vine tendrils curling up from the palm, the white flowers on her horns open; a fierce, quiet look.
formal: At a clan rite beneath the old trellises: a long gown of fine vine-fibre cloth dyed deep leaf green, closing down the front with small wooden buttons, fitted sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with vine leaves, a wreath of white-flowered vine laid over her horns, bare feet. She carries the half cracked clay pot in both hands before her, a serene, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pomegranate-red eyes looking at the viewer over the cracked clay pot she holds near her chin, a single new leaf unfurling from the soil in it. Warm low dusk light from one side, a dim green glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting seeds and grass fluff, the coil of a vine as thick as a gateway at the edge of the frame. She wears the undyed vine-fibre dress.

name: 希瑟娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3929
who: Sithea, called One Cry a Thousand Wings, a winged demon-kin, the wing-caller who alone could turn all of the hundreds of winged clans south of the line with one cry; a legend whose name was fixed at eighty-five, looking just past thirty ever since: about 172 cm, light-boned and lean, long-armed. Violet short hair cut above the ears so it never tangles at the wing roots. Ice-blue eyes. A pair of small horns lying flat behind the ears. A pair of ash-grey feathered wings on her back, half again as broad as other winged folk, each wing edged with a band of white feathers; folded, they still look broader than her body. Many loops of small bone beads wound round her neck, one bead for each clan that joined her. No other jewellery. A quick, clear-voiced, watchful air; she listens to a voice before she looks at a face.
build: 172 cm, lean and light-boned: strong shoulders and back for flight, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: ash grey and white feather, violet, ice blue, bone ivory, dusk lilac
casual: Her roost dress: a short sleeveless dark leather jerkin laced up the front, its back cut with two slits for the wings and the slit edges bound in soft hide, over a long-sleeved fitted lilac-grey wool shirt, dark close-fitting trousers and soft calf boots; the loops of bone beads at her throat. Her right fingertips touch the innermost loop of beads, the wings folded, a listening, alert look.
private: At the cliff roost at sunset: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic with slits at the back for the wings, dark trousers, barefoot, the wings loosely folded. She rolls one bone bead between finger and thumb, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Calling the whole flock against the cannon line: an over-designed war harness of pale carved bone plates laced over dark leather, sculpted bone pauldrons shaped like layered feathers, long dusk-lilac ribbons streaming from the shoulders, a tall collar of interlocking bone beads glowing ice blue around her throat, the white-edged wings folded close behind her with every white feather shining. She carries no weapon and leads by voice alone: one hand lifted with the fingers spread to direct the flock, the other at the bone beads at her throat, a fierce, commanding look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: tense and commanding, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, the wings folded close behind her, one hand lifted to the level of her face with the fingers spread as if directing a flock, the other hand at the bone beads at her throat, a fierce expression; she carries no weapon.
formal: At a gathering of the winged clans on the high cliff: a long ash-grey gown of fine wool with a slit back for the wings, closing down the front with small bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a short white feather mantle over the shoulders, the loops of bone beads at her throat, soft boots. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, the wings folded, a calm, proud look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes looking up and past the viewer, the lips parted on a call, one hand at the bone beads at her throat, the huge ash-grey white-edged wings spread wide behind her against the sky. Cold high-altitude light from one side, a red-orange flash of cannon fire far below on the other. Foreground blur: hundreds of distant wings, drifting grey and white feathers.

name: 埃弗拉德·维尔滕
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3949
who: Everard Welten, called Drop-the-Gate, a human, Lord Keeper of the Seal of the Dawn empire and once a southern-wall gate commander, a hundred and twenty-seven and looking a little past fifty for his hero's rank: tall, about 184 cm, broad-chested and heavy-boned, the right shoulder sitting a hand lower than the left from years of hauling a gate cable (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Frost-white short hair combed straight back, a short trimmed white beard around the chin. Dark green eyes that look at a person's shoulders first. Across the palm of the right hand a straight old cable scar. A heavy seal and, beside it, a polished iron gate ring hang at his belt. No jewellery. A slow, grave air; he gives two numbers before any opinion.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's face of a little past fifty, square and heavy-browed, deep lines at the eyes and between the brows, dark green eyes under white brows, frost-white hair combed straight back, a short trimmed white beard around the chin and jaw; fair skin.
build: 184 cm, tall, broad-chested and heavy-boned, the right shoulder lower than the left.
palette: deep seal blue and iron-grey mail, frost white, dark green, polished iron, a little wax red
casual: His office dress: a long deep blue Lord Keeper's robe to the shins, closing down the front with a straight row of plain buttons, fitted sleeves, and under it his old riveted mail shirt showing at the collar and cuffs; a wide leather belt with the heavy seal and the polished iron gate ring hung side by side; dark boots. He holds a thin ledger of names in his left hand, the right thumb pressing a page, a grave, level look.
private: At his narrow house inside the south gate: a plain long-sleeved grey wool shirt, a dark waistcoat, dark trousers, soft boots, no robe and no mail. He holds a folded muster roll he has not yet struck a name from, a heavy, quiet look.
battle: Back on the gate as in the old days: the old riveted mail with dented iron plates over the chest and shoulders, the right pauldron worn bright where a gate cable ran over it, a short dark blue surcoat, leather gauntlets, the gate ring at the belt. A tall rectangular wall shield on his left arm, its rim worn to bare iron with faint iron-grey runes glowing along the edge, a plain broad arming sword held low in his right hand, a hard, steady look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced like a falling gate, the shoulders squared with the right one lower, the feet planted wide, the tall wall shield set forward on his left arm and a plain broad sword held low in the right, a hard, steady expression.
formal: At the throne hall as Lord Keeper: a floor-length deep blue robe of heavy wool with silver-grey borders, closing down the front with silver buttons, a short mantle clasped at the shoulder, the heavy seal hung on a chain at his chest, the iron gate ring at his belt, the white hair combed flat. He stands very upright, the hands folded before him, a grave, formal look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark green eyes looking at the viewer under white brows, heavy and unsmiling, the scarred right palm resting on the polished iron gate ring. Cold grey light through a high window on one side, the warm red of a sealing-wax lamp on the other. Foreground blur: the iron teeth of a falling portcullis, drifting dust, a page of names.

name: 沃尔夫冈·罗克兰男爵
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3970
who: Baron Wolfgang Rockland, a human noble, third of his house to command the magic-crystal cannon batteries on the northern edge of the deadlands, fifty-eight and looking about forty for his rank: about 181 cm, straight-backed and lean. Pale gold hair cut very short. Ice-blue eyes. An old burn scar spreading from the left cheek down the side of the neck (on the viewer's right when he faces us), from a night when he was eleven. A bone whistle for calling the guns hangs on a cord at his chest. No glasses and no jewellery. A clipped, exact air; he speaks like someone reading clauses of law.
build: 181 cm, lean and straight-backed, narrow-waisted, strong in the shoulders.
palette: deep navy blue and raven black, pale gold, ice blue, bone white, magic-crystal violet glow
casual: His battery command dress: a fitted deep navy military coat to the knee, closing down the front with a row of dark buttons, a short shoulder cape edged all round with a ring of raven feathers, a narrow sword belt with a slim straight rapier at the left hip, dark breeches and tall black boots; the bone whistle on its cord at his chest. He stands very straight, one gloved hand resting on the rapier hilt, a cold, exact look.
private: At the battery quarters at night: the coat off, a plain white shirt with a soft fold-over collar and the sleeves buttoned, a dark waistcoat, dark breeches and boots, the bone whistle still at his chest. He holds an open book of battery orders, a tired, rigid look.
battle: Commanding the battery line: the navy coat over a slim enchanted breastplate and gorget engraved with rune lines that glow a faint crystal violet, the raven-feathered shoulder cape, black gauntlets. He holds the bone whistle raised near his lips in the left hand and the slim straight rapier drawn low in the right, a cold, ready look.
formal: Before the cathedral court with his house's petition: a full-dress deep navy coat with silver braid at the collar and cuffs, the raven-feather cape, the Rockland crest, a black raven with spread wings in silver thread, on the chest, a sash across the body, white gloves, the bone whistle at his chest. He stands very upright, the hands at his sides, a stiff, unyielding look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes looking hard at the viewer, the burn scar on the left cheek and neck in the light, the bone whistle in his fingers near his lips. Cold violet light of a magic-crystal battery from one side, grey dusk on the other. Foreground blur: drifting raven feathers, a silver testing cup with a small flame burning in it.

name: 约里克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3992
who: Yorick, called Shore-Anchor, a half-orc of the Ochre Ridge who grew up on the chain-boats of the Salt Sea's east shore, forty-nine and looking about twenty-two: very tall, about 212 cm, a head and a half taller than an ordinary human, shoulders so broad he turns sideways through a cabin door. Grey-green skin. Brick-red hair, the sides shaved clean and the middle plaited into one short braid. Light green eyes. Two tusks rising from the lower jaw; the left one is bound with a copper band where it cracked biting a chain (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Both forearms ringed with polished chain marks. A grappling chain wound around his waist, its iron claw at the small of his back. A loud, warm, big-hearted air; he looks first at whether you have gone thin.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young half-orc man's face of about twenty-two, broad and strong-jawed, light green eyes, brick-red brows, a wide flat nose, two lower tusks with the left one (on the viewer's right when he faces us) bound with a copper band; grey-green skin with very little shading.
build: 212 cm, very tall and massive: huge shoulders and back, thick arms, a deep chest, a heavy stride.
palette: grey-green skin, brick red, chain-iron grey, salt-stained canvas, copper
casual: His chain-boat dress: a sleeveless salt-stained canvas vest laced up the front over a dark blue wool undershirt with the sleeves cut off, wide dark canvas trousers and heavy boots; the grappling chain wound three times around his waist as a belt, its iron claw hooked at the small of his back. He holds a hard heel of bread out in one big hand as if offering it, a broad grin.
private: In the east-shore harbour at dusk: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up and the chain marks on his forearms showing, wide trousers, barefoot, no chain. He holds a bowl of stew in both hands, a tired, warm look.
battle: Hauling a chain of boats against the tide: a heavy leather harness with iron rings at the shoulders over the canvas vest, leather bracers over the chain marks, the boots braced. He grips the heavy grappling chain unwound in both hands, the four-pronged iron claw swinging at its end, the links glowing faintly with ochre runes, a fierce, grinning look.
formal: At the east-shore harbour gathering: a clean dark blue wool coat cut wide for his shoulders, closing down the front with brass buttons, a white shirt, a red-ochre sash, polished boots, the copper band on his tusk polished bright, the chain wound neatly at his waist. He stands upright, the big hands clasped in front, a proud, slightly embarrassed grin.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the light green eyes wide as he shouts a call across the water, the copper-banded tusk bright, a taut chain over his shoulder. Grey storm light and driving rain from one side, a lantern on a boat prow on the other. Foreground blur: rain streaks, salt spray, heavy iron links.

name: 赞博
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4012
who: Zambo, called Bone Bell, a demon-kin of the White Bones, master of the bone-joiners who keep the clan's walking siege colossi, a hundred and sixty-five and looking in his early forties: about 180 cm, long-limbed and spare. Ash-grey skin, with smooth ridges of white bone showing through it along both cheekbones and the collarbones. Dark green long hair gathered at the back of the head into one tail held by three bone rings. A pair of short horns curving forward, their roots bound with bone hoops. Pale cyan eyes like will-o'-the-wisp fire. A bone ring on every one of his ten knuckles, which clatter when he touches anything. In his right hand a bell mallet carved from a leg bone; an old split runs across that palm. A slow, patient, craftsman's air; he raps a thing before he speaks.
build: 180 cm, lean and long-limbed, wiry strong forearms.
palette: ash grey and bone white, dark green, pale cyan phosphor glow, dark felt grey
casual: His bone-joiner's dress: a thick grey felt cloak with a ring of bone toggles along the hem, over a dark leather work apron hung with small bone awls and cord, a grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbow, dark trousers and soft felt boots. He holds the leg-bone bell mallet low in his right hand, a calm, considering look.
private: In the bone-joiners' tent: the cloak off, a long-sleeved grey wool tunic, dark trousers, felt boots. He turns a small joined bone over in his fingers to check it, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Driving the colossi against the tower: a harness of fitted bone plates laced over dark leather, the plates carved with joining runes that glow pale cyan, bone bracers, the felt cloak thrown back, a short shoulder mantle of white bone tags. He raises the leg-bone bell mallet in his right hand to strike, pale cyan light running along it and along his knuckle rings, a hard, intent look.
formal: At the bell muster of his camp: a long dark grey felt coat to the shins, closing down the front with a row of bone buttons, a white sash, the master joiner's mark of a bone and a bell cut in white bone at the chest, the hair tail freshly bound with its three bone rings, felt boots. He holds the bell mallet upright before him in both hands, a grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes looking down at the viewer, the bell mallet raised beside his face, a huge bell made of a giant's ribs looming behind his shoulder. Cold grey ash-storm light from one side, the pale cyan glow of the bones on the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash and bone dust, small bone fragments rising toward the sound.
